page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is a storage-focused virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 16 physical cores and a single thread per core. It includes 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, consisting of 47244 GB of local hard disk drive storage. This high-density storage configuration is bundled directly with the instance. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.d1.4xlarge lies in its storage medium. While it offers exceptionally high storage density and qualitative cost efficiency per gigabyte for large-scale data retention, the use of HDD storage results in higher latency and lower random IOPS compared to solid-state drives. The older Intel Xeon processor architecture also lacks modern vector extensions such as AVX-512. Consequently, this instance is designed for workloads requiring massive sequential data storage, such as MapReduce jobs, distributed file systems, large-scale data warehousing, and cold data archiving.
